title: Workflow for Generating HMW Plant DNA for Third Generation Sequencing
author: Patrick Driguez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bafmibk6
materials: Quantify the DNA and check the quality Use ds BR Qubit assay for DNA quantification Qubit™ dsDNA BR Assay Kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q32853 Use Nanodrop to check the quality: A 260/280 ratio of 1.8-2.0 and 260/230 ratio of 2.0-2.2 is ideal This measures contamination with carbohydrates and other contaminants. The 260/230 ratio must be > 2 as sugars disrupt the polymerase during sequencing. - If 260/230 is low proceed with a gentle AMPure PB Bead clean and re-do the Nanodrop. Only very high molecular weight DNA is lost.

The following protocol is based on the "QIAGEN Genomic DNA Handbook" available at www.qiagen.com. We follow the recommendations for tissue with modifications. For 1 g of ground leaf tissue prepare enough Lysis Buffer for 4 x 100/G, or 1-2 x 500/G tip columns. The suitable number of columns per gram of tissue is plant species-dependent. The optimal loading for the best yield should be determined for each species taking care to not to over-load the columns.
Prechill a high speed centrifuge to 4 °C

Pulse Field Gel Electrophoresis 1% agarose TBE gel over 24 hours (Initial switch 1 sec, finial switch 25 sec, 6 volt/cm, 120° included angle, Chef III, Bio-Rad, Hercules, CA, USA) Midrange PFG and Lambda PFG markers (N0342S, N0341S, NEB, Ipswich, MA, USA).

The 260/230 ratio must be > 2 as sugars disrupt the polymerase during sequencing. - If 260/230 is low proceed with a gentle AMPure PB Bead clean and re-do the Nanodrop. steps.title: Prepare Mortar and Pestle
steps.instruction: Cool the mortar and pestle to cryogenic temperatures using liquid nitrogen.

substeps.instruction: Add excess liquid nitrogen to the mortar and pestle in a tray.
Allow most of the liquid nitrogen to evaporate until the equipment reaches cryogenic temperatures.

steps.title: Grind Plant Tissue
steps.instruction: Grind more than 1 g of frozen leaves into a very fine powder.

substeps.instruction: Grind > 1 g of frozen leaves in the pre-cooled mortar and pestle.
Add small amounts of liquid nitrogen as needed to maintain cryogenic temperatures.
Optionally resuspend powder in a small amount of liquid nitrogen to facilitate transfer to storage tubes.

steps.title: Lysis and Proteinase K Digestion
steps.instruction: Lyse the ground powder and digest proteins using Proteinase K.

substeps.instruction: Add Lysis buffer to the ground powder (volume based on the purification column type used).
Resuspend by gently inverting end-over-end; dispense into multiple tubes if necessary.
Add Proteinase K (Qiagen Catalog #19131): 500 µL per 100/G column or 1000 µL per 500/G column.
Tighten cap, cover with Parafilm, and mix by inversion.
Incubate for > 3.5 hours at 50°C with slow rocking (place tube at a slight tilt so liquid moves slightly; use a platform rocker in a preheated incubator/shaker with NO SHAKING).

steps.title: Prepare Elution Buffer
steps.instruction: Preheat buffer QF in a Falcon tube using a 50°C waterbath.

substeps.instruction: Use 5 mL per 100/G column or 15 mL per 500/G column.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysed samples to remove debris.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge 50 mL tubes for 15 minutes at room temperature at maximum speed (3220 x g / 4000 rpm) with maximum acceleration and deceleration (=9).
If large amounts of debris remain in the supernatant, repeat centrifugation for up to 15 minutes.

steps.title: Column Purification
steps.instruction: Purify DNA using Genomic tip columns.

substeps.instruction: Pour the supernatant into a pre-calibrated Genomic tip column and allow it to elute (average 10-20 mins).
Add 1 mL of wash buffer QC along the walls of the tube to precipitate debris; aspirate debris from the bottom. Repeat with another 1 mL of QC buffer if debris persists.
Wash the column twice with buffer QC: 2 x 7.5 mL for 100/G columns or 2 x 15 mL for 500/G columns (each wash may take at least 15 mins).
Transfer the column to a clean 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the column using pre-heated buffer QF.

substeps.instruction: Apply 5 mL of 50°C buffer QF per 100/G column or 15 mL per 500/G column.
Allow elution to proceed (typically 15 min, but can take up to 1 hour per sample).
Add 2-Propanol (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #190764) along the wall of the tube: 3.5 mL per 100/G column or 10.5 mL per 500/G column.
Mix gently by slowly inverting the tube until a visible mass of HMW DNA (a "jellyfish") forms.
Stop mixing once the pellet is slightly compacted.

steps.title: Recover and Wash DNA
steps.instruction: Capture the DNA pellet and wash to remove starch.

substeps.instruction: Capture the HMW DNA pellet using a disposable inoculation loop, trapping the pellet in the center of the loop.
Transfer the DNA on the loop to a 1.5 mL tube containing 1 mL of fresh 80% ethanol.
Repeat the ethanol wash twice more using two separate tubes of fresh 80% ethanol.

steps.title: Dry and Dissolve DNA
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and resuspend in TE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Air dry the DNA pellet for 30-60 seconds.
Dissolve the pellet in 50 µL to 100 µL of TE buffer (pH 8.0) in a new 1.5 mL tube by cutting off the end of the loop with scissors.
Leave overnight at room temperature for resuspension.

steps.title: Homogenize and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Finalize resuspension and analyze DNA size.

substeps.instruction: Remove the loop and homogenize the solution using wide-bore tips with slow aspiration and discharge (3 seconds up, 3 seconds down).
If not fully resuspended, use a slow shaker or incubate at 4°C (do not apply heat).
Analyze DNA size distribution using Pulse Field Gel Electrophoresis or FEMTO Pulse analysis (gDNA 165 kb kit FP-1002-0275 on the Femto Pulse system).

steps.title: Alternative Precipitation (Cold Centrifugation)
steps.instruction: Use this procedure if the "jellyfish" mass did not form during 2-propanol addition.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge samples at 5000 x g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and wash with 1 mL 80% ethanol.
Carefully pour off supernatant without resuspending; drain at 45° on a paper towel to dry.
Wash two more times.
Centrifuge at 5000 x g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and dry.
Resuspend in TE buffer (pH 8.0) and proceed to resuspension and quality control steps.

steps.title: Column Calibration
steps.instruction: Calibrate the Genomic tip columns before use.

substeps.instruction: Place the column inside the placolumneeve on top of a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Add calibration buffer QBT: 4 mL per 100/G column or 10 mL per 500/G column.
Ensure all QBT passes through the column.
